Fact.Name: Has a prior-year qualified business loss or REIT/PTP loss carryforward
Fact.Description: Form 8995 (2026) draft line 3: "Qualified business net (loss) carryforward from the prior year"; line 7: "Qualified REIT dividends and qualified PTP (loss) carryforward from the prior year". 26 U.S.C. 199A(c)(2): a negative amount "shall be treated as a loss from a qualified trade or business in the succeeding taxable year". Carryforwards are not modeled, so "yes" is a stop (/flowKnockoutQbiPriorYearCarryforward).

Fact.Name: Is a patron of an agricultural or horticultural cooperative
Fact.Description: Form 8995 (2026) draft header: "Use this form if your taxable income, before your qualified business income deduction, is at or below $201,750 ($201,775 if married filing separately; $403,500 if married filing jointly), and you aren't a patron of an agricultural or horticultural cooperative." A patron files Form 8995-A, which is not supported (/flowKnockoutQbiCooperativePatron). 26 U.S.C. 199A(b)(7), (g).

Fact.Name: Return has Schedule C qualified business income or loss
Fact.Description: Schedule C net profit or loss is qualified business income or loss: 26 U.S.C. 199A(c)(1), (c)(3). Follows scheduleC /scheduleCNetProfitOrLoss for an unset business list: complete false when the self-employment question is unanswered or "no", true on "yes" (the lines then stay incomplete until the list is filled in).

Fact.Name: Section 199A threshold amount (Form 8995 limit)
Fact.Description: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §3.26, PDF pp. 21-22: "For taxable years beginning in 2026, the threshold amounts under § 199A(e)(2) ... are: Married Individuals Filing Joint Returns $403,500 ... Married Individuals Filing Separate Returns $201,775 ... All Other Returns $201,750". Form 8995 (2026) draft header: "at or below $201,750 ($201,775 if married filing separately; $403,500 if married filing jointly)". Above it, Form 8995-A applies.

Fact.Name: Section 199A(i) minimum deduction
Fact.Description: 26 U.S.C. 199A(i)(1): the deduction "shall be equal to the greater of— (A) the amount of such deduction determined without regard to this subsection, or (B) $400." Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §2.12, PDF p. 7: "Section 70105 of the OBBBA amended § 199A(i) to add a minimum deduction of $400 ... The $400 and $1,000 amounts in § 199A(i) will be adjusted for inflation for taxable years beginning after 2026."

Fact.Name: Section 199A(i) active QBI floor for the minimum deduction
Fact.Description: 26 U.S.C. 199A(i)(2)(A): "a taxpayer whose aggregate qualified business income with respect to all active qualified trades or businesses of the taxpayer for such taxable year is at least $1,000." Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §2.12, PDF p. 7 (not indexed for 2026).

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 2
Fact.Description: Line 2: "Total qualified business income or (loss). Combine lines 1i through 1v, column (c)." Each Schedule C business's QBI is its net profit or loss reduced by the deductible part of self-employment tax: Instructions for Form 8995 (2025), PDF p. 2: "To figure the total amount of QBI, you must consider all items that are attributable to the trade or business. This includes, but isn't limited to, ... deductible part of self-employment tax, self-employment health insurance deduction, and contributions to qualified retirement plans." Treas. Reg. 1.199A-3(b)(1)(vi). The total is scheduleC /scheduleCNetProfitOrLoss minus scheduleSE /deductibleSelfEmploymentTax (Schedule 1 line 15). Schedule 1 lines 16 and 17 are not part of this return.

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 3
Fact.Description: Line 3: "Qualified business net (loss) carryforward from the prior year". $0: any carryforward is a stop (/flowKnockoutQbiPriorYearCarryforward).

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 4
Fact.Description: Line 4: "Total qualified business income. Combine lines 2 and 3. If zero or less, enter -0-".

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 5
Fact.Description: Line 5: "Qualified business income component. Multiply line 4 by 20% (0.20)". 26 U.S.C. 199A(b)(2)(A): "20 percent of the taxpayer's qualified business income".

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 6
Fact.Description: Line 6: "Qualified REIT dividends and publicly traded partnership (PTP) income or (loss)". $0: 1099-DIV box 5 (dividends /flowKnockoutSection199ADividends) and PTP income (scheduleE /flowKnockoutScheduleEPartII) are stops.

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 7
Fact.Description: Line 7: "Qualified REIT dividends and qualified PTP (loss) carryforward from the prior year". $0: any carryforward is a stop (/flowKnockoutQbiPriorYearCarryforward).

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 8
Fact.Description: Line 8: "Total qualified REIT dividends and PTP income. Combine lines 6 and 7. If zero or less, enter -0-".

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 9
Fact.Description: Line 9: "REIT and PTP component. Multiply line 8 by 20% (0.20)". 26 U.S.C. 199A(b)(1)(B).

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 10
Fact.Description: Line 10: "Qualified business income deduction before the income limitation. Add lines 5 and 9".

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 11
Fact.Description: Line 11: "Taxable income before qualified business income deduction". Instructions for Form 8995 (2025), PDF p. 4, Line 11: "Form 1040 or 1040-SR filers: Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11a, minus lines 12e and 13b." On the 2026 draft Form 1040 that is AGI minus every line 14 deduction except 13b: lines 12e (standard or itemized), 12f (charitable, non-itemizer) and 13a (Schedule 1-A line 44). 26 U.S.C. 199A(e)(1): taxable income is "computed ... without regard to any deduction allowable under this section". Not below zero, like Form 1040 line 15.

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 12
Fact.Description: Line 12: "Enter your net capital gain, if any, increased by any qualified dividends." Instructions for Form 8995 (2025), PDF p. 4, Line 12: "Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 3a, plus your net capital gain. If you're not required to file Schedule D (Form 1040), your net capital gain is the amount reported on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 7a. If you file Schedule D (Form 1040), your net capital gain is the smaller of Schedule D (Form 1040), line 15 or 16, unless line 15 or 16 is zero or less, in which case nothing is added to the qualified dividends." That is the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet line 4 (scheduleD3 /qdcgLine4: line 3a plus the same Schedule D / line 7a amount). 26 U.S.C. 199A(a)(2)(B) and 1(h).

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 13
Fact.Description: Line 13: "Subtract line 12 from line 11. If zero or less, enter -0-".

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 14
Fact.Description: Line 14: "Income limitation. Multiply line 13 by 20% (0.20)". 26 U.S.C. 199A(a)(2): "an amount equal to 20 percent of the excess (if any) of— (A) the taxable income of the taxpayer for the taxable year, over (B) the net capital gain (as defined in section 1(h))".

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 15
Fact.Description: Line 15: "Qualified business income deduction before the minimum deduction for active qualified business income. Enter the smaller of line 10 or line 14". 26 U.S.C. 199A(a): "the lesser of".

Fact.Name: Aggregate QBI from active trades or businesses
Fact.Description: 26 U.S.C. 199A(i)(2)(A): "aggregate qualified business income with respect to all active qualified trades or businesses". When every business is active this is line 2; when none is, $0. A return with both active and non-active businesses would need the self-employment tax deduction apportioned per business, so it is a stop (/flowKnockoutQbiMixedParticipation) and this value is not used.

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 16
Fact.Description: Line 16: "Minimum deduction for active qualified business income (see instructions)". 26 U.S.C. 199A(i): $400 (/qbiMinimumDeductionAmount) for an applicable taxpayer, one whose active aggregate QBI is "at least $1,000" (/qbiMinimumActiveQbiAmount); otherwise $0.

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 17
Fact.Description: Line 17: "Qualified business income deduction. Enter the greater of line 15 or line 16. Also enter this amount on the applicable line of your return." That is Form 1040 (2026) draft line 13b (taxCalculations /qualifiedBusinessIncomeDeduction).

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 18
Fact.Description: Line 18: "Total qualified business (loss) carryforward. Combine lines 2 and 3. If greater than zero, enter -0-". Carried to next year under 26 U.S.C. 199A(c)(2). Kept as a negative amount; the form shows it in parentheses.

Fact.Name: Form 8995 line 19
Fact.Description: Line 19: "Total qualified REIT dividends and PTP (loss) carryforward. Combine lines 6 and 7. If greater than zero, enter -0-".

Fact.Name: Form 8995 is filed
Fact.Description: The return has Schedule C qualified business income or loss (a loss still files Form 8995 to report the line 18 carryforward).

Fact.Name: Knockout: taxable income before the QBI deduction is above the Form 8995 threshold (Form 8995-A)
Fact.Description: Form 8995 (2026) draft header: "Use this form if your taxable income, before your qualified business income deduction, is at or below" the threshold (/qbiThresholdAmount). Above it the W-2 wage and UBIA limits and the specified service rules of 26 U.S.C. 199A(b)(2)(B), (b)(3) and (d)(3) apply on Form 8995-A, which is not supported. Complete false without Schedule C income (#186).

Fact.Name: Knockout: prior-year QBI or REIT/PTP loss carryforward
Fact.Description: Cites on /qbiHasPriorYearLossCarryforward. Complete false without Schedule C income or on "no"; incomplete while a filer with Schedule C income hasn't answered (#186).

Fact.Name: Knockout: patron of an agricultural or horticultural cooperative (Form 8995-A)
Fact.Description: Cites on /qbiIsCooperativePatron. Complete false without Schedule C income or on "no" (#186).

Fact.Name: Knockout: some Schedule C businesses are active and some are not
Fact.Description: The 26 U.S.C. 199A(i)(2)(A) test counts QBI only from businesses with material participation, and each business's QBI is reduced by its share of the deductible part of self-employment tax (Treas. Reg. 1.199A-3(b)(1)(vi)). That apportionment is not modeled, so a return with both active and non-active businesses is stopped. Complete false without Schedule C income or when every business has the same answer (#186).
